version.approval_notes: Self-distributed single-user password manager for a user-supplied HTTPS Vaultwarden/Bitwarden-compatible server. Matching readable sources, a pinned npm lockfile, rebuild instructions, unit tests and third-party library references are in the source ZIP. Rebuild with Node 24.22.1 and Python 3.11.4+: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; npm test; npm run build; python3 tools/package-extension.py. Compare the unsigned output XPI before Mozilla signature files are added. Only server/email/device identifier persist; master password and vault keys stay in memory. Runtime code/WASM are local. Functional review requires a disposable HTTPS vault/account; the source ZIP includes lockbox.py and SELF_HOSTING.md for setup. No real user account credentials are included. Privacy details are in extension/release/privacy.md. Firefox desktop/Android minimum 142; Android acceptance so far used Nightly. hash-wasm 4.12.0, tldts/tldts-core 7.4.19 and esbuild 0.28.2 are public unmodified npm releases with exact integrity values in package-lock.json. Every passkey approval requires a fresh master-password check. This is not a public AMO listing submission.
